about: Limits measure.py --package realistic --check holds the realistic body to (Character Studio overhaul CO4 and CO5). A measure is named by its path in measurements.json. at_most and at_least are what the build has reached and must keep (they only tighten; never loosen one without renders showing the cause isn't visible, and the lead's agreement). within holds each proportion to 12.5% either side of Drillis and Contini's figure (the stylized body is outside most of them). targets are the targets of docs/development/character-studio/testing.md the build has not reached: --check prints them as not met and still passes on the limits; --strict fails on them too. A target moves into at_least when it is met. The shoulder at 90 degrees is held by its local volume (CO4's 0.78; targets the stylized body's 0.853 and 0.992). At 150 degrees it is held by its ring area, at what CO5's corrective shapes reached (0.929 and 0.82), not by its local volume: Paul's decision of 2026-11-16 (docs/development/character-studio/progress.md), because the local volume rewards an inflated cap (a shape that read 0.86 showed a step and a ball in the engine) while the ring area and the reviewed sheets follow what is seen. The 150 degree local volume is still measured and reported. The sliders entries need measure.py --only with sliders in the list (every pair of the manifest's parameters at the ends of their ranges, both frames, in the rest pose): no body may newly cross itself, and no shape slider may put skin in the eyes or the teeth. The hanging arm swung forward 40 degrees and back 50 (shoulder_swing_forward_40, shoulder_swing_back_50, as the starter Walk swings it; their corrective shapes since wave 4, CO9 part 2) is held by its ring area at what the build reached less about 0.01 (0.908 / 0.939 forward, 0.963 / 0.974 back; local volume 0.989 / 0.931 and 0.972 / 0.923, reported). The shoulder lowered to hang (shoulder_abd_10, as the starter Idle holds the arms: 35 degrees below the A-pose the body is skinned in) is held to no bulge: before its Lowered corrective shapes it gained 12.5 / 9.3% of its local volume (a squared cap and a ridge beside the neck); with them 1.024 / 0.986, held at most 1.03 / 0.99, and its ring area at least 0.9 / 0.96 (docs/development/character-studio/lowered-shoulder/).
